name: AI Editor
description: Makes short video clips (Veo) and a narration (ElevenLabs) from your content, has the connected compose service (Shotstack, Creatomate or JSON2Video) join them into one captioned video; nothing is published until you have watched and approved it.
points.0: Makes a video clip for each scene of the script
points.1: Reads the script aloud and joins everything into one captioned video
purpose: a video assistant that makes short video clips and a narration from the business's own content, has a connected cloud compose service join them into one captioned video, keeps the files, and never publishes without the owner's approval
